nativeStartup.visibilityScope: Observed native show state and actual native key window after shell first paint
nativeStartup.activationScope: Automated Electron activate event, not physical Dock input
nativeStartup.providerScope: Empty isolated session; no authentication, provider navigation or live model task

stages: Production macOS shell creates three sandboxed isolated native chat views and keeps its browser session in memory.
Import and Normal OK open exactly three distinct chats with the boss coordinator active.
A mixed text, valid PDF and PNG source selection reaches all three native file inputs; Reset clears the staged previews and retains the session.
One native file picker uploads the original source to the boss and both workers.
The boss writes distinct worker instructions, receives both results and exact generated files every cycle, then both workers verify one final candidate after four improvement cycles.
The real boss composer accepts an instruction during worker generation, delivers it in the next boss context, and completes the run with no queued message left behind.
Native Save downloads the actual accepted file and matches the coordinator SHA-256, with the requested corrected values.
The settings selector applies Horror, Alien, Night, Cyberpunk and Anime backgrounds to all three real chat views.
Robot, Explorer and Spirit character choices apply without changing the active chat run or its accepted files.
Clicking the center boss opens and closes its sliding native chat panel while preserving the worker workspace.
A follow-up reuses all three conversations; a new instruction while the boss generates is queued safely.
Stop cancels active boss generation and prevents queued instructions from restarting the stopped run.
Stop also cancels both workers during their concurrent generation, retaining each completed conversation.
Reset clears all three chats without clearing the imported session; Work mode is verified on the fresh boss and worker pages.
Temporary mode is also verified on all three new chats through its visible page controls.
Unreadable boss control output receives one format repair, then stops safely without dispatching an invented worker task or clearing the session.
Actual desktop app starts with sandboxed isolated pages and an in-memory browser session.
Import clears its field and retains the in-memory cookie while waiting for the selected chat type and OK.
Normal OK opens both sandboxed pages with visibly off Temporary and Personalized state; no privacy gate blocks the mode.
A reload hydrates the Ask ChatGPT rich editor and refreshes its ready status instead of reporting a signed-out session.
Expand B hides A and enlarges only B inside the shell; Restore split returns both native page bounds.
Start completes ten real IPC sends across four full improvement rounds: independent drafts, challenge, corrected image/file transfer and eight fresh reviews before exact dual acceptance.
A second improvement command completes four fresh rounds in the same two chats with new request identities and all previous page turns intact.
Auto recognizes simple arithmetic and finishes after two independently submitted verification responses, while retaining the same pair.
Native Attach reads a real source PDF into both chats; generated PDF revisions are relayed for exact-file review and final accepted bytes save as a valid PDF.
Stop during PDF review preserves the completed candidate; explicit Save current files writes its exact bytes and no late review is sent.
Native Attach accepts an original .txt EA source on both isolated pages without executing its code.

Live-shaped inline .mq5 Download spans are detected, changed bytes become C2, and eight fresh reviews receive complete original and verified current-candidate JSON source readbacks plus one byte-identical .mq5.txt candidate alias across four rounds.
Host Save preserves the generated .mq5 extension and exactly matches the revised file SHA-256 checked by both reviewers.
A next arithmetic command reuses the same EA chats, clears source/file/code/evidence requirements and finishes two independent verification steps.
Missing requested six-month native MT5 report keeps the task unfinished even when reviewers accept the source; no live trading or tester execution is performed.
Reset retains cookies and mode selection; Temporary OK automatically toggles both pages and runs with their Personalized default.
Work OK activates a unique visible Work control and requires observed selected state before exchanging prompts.
A malformed model reply stops with an explanation while preserving cookies, the two chat histories, and next-command availability.
Native page bounds remain inside the shell; compositor screenshots captured when available, with unsupported captures reported.
Stop during an unfinished generated-file export aborts its fetch and prevents a late review from being submitted.
Header Stop remains accessible with the sidebar hidden and cancels both native page generations.
An unavailable Work control blocks Start with a page explanation instead of guessing a URL or silently running Normal mode.
A source file confirmed on only one page shows a partial attachment error and blocks Start while retaining the session.
Clear session removes the imported cookie, resets local run state and unloads both pages.

limits: No physical MacBook Air M4 test or live authenticated Mac task.
File selection and Save use offline dialog hooks in workflow fixtures.
No fresh Finder installation or quarantined first launch exercised.
No Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.
No quantitative GPU, battery or thermal measurements.
Native activation is an automated Electron event, not a physical Dock click.
Startup image captures initial paint before the version badge settles; native report checks rendered version.
Fixture CSP warnings and host sandbox XPC notices are not production-provider failures.
